scenario: `t.dwell` is only well-defined on logical-schema bindings per LFAC.1.4.2. Applied to a ttl-schema binding, the validator rejects with DS_VALIDATE_DWELL_TTL_SCHEMA pointing at the spec'd alternative (`now() - <binding>.<event-ts-slot>`). Pin: `where e.dwell > 60` on a ttl schema rejects.
rules_ds:
schema Evt scope ttl 1_min:
    code: String
    ts: Time

rule stale:
    Evt e where e.dwell > 60
->
    log info "x"
